.gstudio/artifacts/class/scripts/create/.instruction: Run {{script}} <name> [content] where <name> is the PascalCase class name and the optional [content] is the class body text.

.gstudio/artifacts/class/scripts/list/st.instruction: Run {{script}} [search term] to list all classes in src/classes, optionally filtered by the given search term.

.gstudio/artifacts/class/scripts/update/.instruction: Run {{script}} <class-name> <change-request> to verify the class file exists before applying the update.

.gstudio/artifacts/class/scripts/delete/.instruction: Run {{script}} <name> where <name> is the PascalCase class name whose file should be deleted.
Run {{script}} <name> to print every remaining reference to the class as `[file path]:[line number]` lines.

.gstudio/artifacts/class/scripts/evaluat.instruction: Run {{script}} <name> where <name> is the PascalCase class name to evaluate (e.g. `{{script}} UserService`).

create.text: Scaffolds a new class file at src/classes/{Name}.class.ts with an empty or given body, failing if the file already exists.

list.text: Lists all classes in src/classes, optionally filtered by a search term, printing each match as its class name and file path.

update.text: Applies a natural-language change request to an existing class file at src/classes given the class name and description, failing if the file doesn't exist.

delete.text: Deletes a class file at src/classes and removes all dangling references to it found elsewhere in the codebase, given the class name.

evaluate.text: Checks that a class file has exactly one top-level named class export and contains no general-purpose utility functions, given the class name as input.
